description.value: The Tannenbaum is a family-run German and Bavarian-inspired restaurant emphasizing fresh, high-quality ingredients and a warm, nostalgic atmosphere. Located in New Westminster, it offers both indoor and outdoor seating and accepts cash, credit, and debit. The restaurant occupies a former Chronic Tacos location and has established itself as a local destination for authentic German cuisine in the Greater Vancouver area.
